technical_requirements: Primary: scalable embeddings for semantic search + nightly bulk jobs (1–2M docs/month). Integration: must plug into existing Postgres + pgvector or Pinecone. Retrieval: top-k within 100ms preferred for UI queries; offline reranking/embedding acceptable up to minutes. Throughput targets: 10k qps not required, expect 50–200 qps peak for search layer, but bulk ingestion needs high sustained throughput. Quotas/cost: cost-sensitivity for tokenized text in batch jobs — looking to reduce per-embed cost by at least 2x compared to hosted POC pricing.
poc_metrics_and_goals: Evaluate hosted API for correctness and dev speed: sample metrics collected — 10k embeddings/hour, avg embed latency 120ms. Goal for Dedicated: 4–6x throughput improvement for bulk jobs (target 500k/hr) and 30% lower per-embed cost. Validate vector DB connector (consistent IDs, upsert latency <200ms) and end-to-end retrieval latency under load.
security_notes: Needs SSO/SAML before production; customer will require audit logs and KMS integration for keys. Data residency: EU tenant for EMEA subset; Redwood asked about region pinning. Legal: standard DPA requested.
integration_notes: Primary vector stores under consideration: pgvector on Heroku Postgres (primary), Pinecone (backup). Engineering prefers minimal changes to existing ingestion pipelines (Python + Airflow). Ask: SDKs for bulk embedding with automatic batching + resume on failures; streaming embedding API for real-time doc updates.
commercial_notes: Mid-market pricing sensitivity. Interested in annual committed Dedicated plan with predictable monthly throughput and overage pricing. Wants clear mapping of committed throughput -> expected latency and per-embed cost. AE provided draft term sheet; procurement kickoff expected after internal finance review in March.
